label: FINAL ROUND · QUICK LOGIC
question: 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes. How long do 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
steps: 5 machines, 5 widgets, 5 minutes means 1 machine makes 1 widget in 5 minutes
100 machines all work at the same time
Each makes 1 widget in 5 minutes, so 100 widgets in 5 minutes. Most people say 100 🙃
tip: Find the rate for one unit first. It's the same move as finding per-share or per-unit numbers in a model.
